title: Trivia Night at Jetty Road Brewery
summary: Weekly Wednesday trivia at Jetty Road Brewery in Dromana. Free entry. From 6:30pm every Wednesday during winter.
accessibilityNotes: Brewery venue; contact for specific access requirements
nearbyAttractions: Dromana foreshore; Arthurs Seat; Crittenden Estate
suggestedItineraryPairing: Dinner at the brewery, trivia from 6:30pm - a full Wednesday evening sorted
editorVerdict: Free trivia at a good craft brewery on a Wednesday night. Simple, reliable, good.
editorNote:
Jetty Road Brewery runs weekly trivia every Wednesday throughout winter. Free to enter, starts 6:30pm, you're in a proper brewery with their full range on tap.

Good for groups staying the week on the Peninsula, or locals who want a mid-week social event that doesn't require much planning. No booking required - just show up. Ends August 26.
